title: wg: rto-01 §4 PartialGroupInfo reconstruction unspecified
description: Suggestion. §4 (L255-320) never says how to rebuild the GroupInfo (which epoch's GroupContext, where confirmation_tag comes from); hub and joiner must agree exactly for the signature to verify. Senders omit ratchet_tree from group_info_extensions (L295, L314) but receiver behaviour if present is unstated. L316-317 calls external_pub "the public key of the external commiter"; in RFC 9420 it is the group's external-join HPKE key (and "commiter" is misspelled). mimid uses the new epoch after merge and rejects a present ratchet_tree (decisions mimid-1wgh.4.20, .4.30).
notes:
Also (from .4.7): the position of the ratchet_tree extension in the rebuilt GroupInfo is unspecified and implementations differ (OpenMLS prepends, mls-rs appends); mimid prepends (mimid-1wgh.4.46).

Verified 2026-10-18: reconstruction PARTLY (RFC 9420 §12.4.3 already fixes GroupContext = new epoch, confirmation_tag = Commit's; missing a normative rule and ratchet_tree position). ratchet_tree-present receiver behaviour CONFIRMED. external_pub wording CONFIRMED (group's external HPKE key; 'commiter' typo). Order: OpenMLS commit_builder.rs:1044-1051 prepends, mls-rs commit.rs:735-743 appends (ordinary GroupInfo; neither implements PartialGroupInfo). Route: one issue + external_pub into editorial PR. Not raised.

Sent 2026-10-18: issue https://github.com/mlswg/mls-ratchet-tree-options/issues/4; external_pub wording in PR #3
